findings.title: the deferral note asserts a relaunch and an "earlier non-ok envelope" on every ordinary first-attempt implement job, because the guard runs before `drive_implement_failed` rather than inside its branch
`escalated_this_pass` is a second, unrequested ladder-wide change with no test of its own — no fixture in the diff ever reaches the sweep-plus-walk collision it exists for
its key is `id:op:point` while its comment justifies the rule "per slot", so two dual-review slots (or two bindings at one hook point) dying in the same pass now spend one rung instead of two
`assert_match "awaiting the implementer envelope"` also matches the pre-existing fallback note, so it does not pin the guard's own path; asserting the parenthetical would
